en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5131 - Yunus narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said that

one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) was asked about the legal punishments (hudud) for a mute, a deaf person, and a blind person.
Imam (as) said: "The legal punishments apply to them if they comprehend what they are doing."
